readings.title: 37. His supplication in giving Thanks
readings.attribution: Arabic, transliteration, and English translation from the Thaqalayn public-page dataset, released under CC0 1.0 Universal.

records.arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ إنَّ أَحَداً لاَ يَبْلُغُ مِنْ شُكْرِكَ غَايَةً إلاّ حَصَلَ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ إحْسَانِكَ مَا يُلْزِمُهُ شُكْرَاً، وَلا يَبْلُغُ مَبْلَغاً مِنْ طَاعَتِكَ وَإن اجْتَهَدَ إلاَّ كَانَ مُقَصِّراً دُونَ اسْتِحْقَاقِكَ بِفَضْلِكَ،
records.transliteration: allahumma innahu la yablughu min shukrika ghayatan illaḥ ḥaṣala ʿalayhi min iḥsanika mā yulzimuhu shukran walā yablughu mablaghan min ta'atika wa in ijtaḥada 'illa kāna muqaṣṣiran dūna istiḥqāqika bifadlik
records.english_text: O God, no one reaches a limit in thanking Thee without acquiring that of Thy beneficence which enjoins upon him thanksgiving, nor does anyone reach a degree in obeying Thee, even if he strives, without falling short of what Thou deservest because of Thy bounty.

records.arabic_text: فَأَشْكَرُ عِبَادِكَ عَاجِزٌ عَنْ شُكْرِكَ وَأَعْبَدُهُمْ مُقَصِّرٌ عَنْ طَاعَتِكَ،
records.transliteration: fa-ashkaru ʿibādika ʿājizun ʿan shukrika wa'aʿbaduhum muqaṣṣirun ʿan ṭaaʿatika
records.english_text: The most thankful of Thy servants has not the capacity to thank Thee, and the most worshipful of them falls short of obeying Thee.

records.arabic_text: لا يَجبُ لأِحَد أَنْ تَغْفِرَ لَهُ بِاسْتِحْقَاقِهِ، وَلا أَنْ تَرْضَى عَنْهُ بِاسْتِيجَابِهِ،
records.transliteration: lā yajubu li'aḥad an taghfira lahū bi-istiḥqāqihi walā an tarḍā ʿanhu bi-istījābih
records.english_text: To none of them is due Thy forgiveness through what he himself deserves or Thy good pleasure for his own merit.

records.arabic_text: فَمَنْ غَفَرْتَ لَهُ فَبِطَولِكَ، وَمَنْ رَضِيْتَ عَنْهُ فَبِفَضْلِكَ
records.transliteration: faman ghafartalahu fabitawlika wa man raḍīta ʿanhu fabi faḍlika
records.english_text: When Thou forgivest someone, it is through Thy graciousness, and when Thou art pleased with someone, it is through Thy bounty.

records.arabic_text: تَشْكُرُ يَسِيرَ مَا شُكِرْتَهُ وَتُثِيبُ عَلَى قَلِيلِ مَا تُطَاعُ فِيهِ حَتَّى كَأَنَّ شُكْـرَ عِبَادِكَ الَّذِيْ أَوْجَبْتَ عَلَيْهِ ثَوَابَهُمْ وَأَعْظَمْتَ عَنْهُ جَزَاءَهُمْ أَمْرٌ مَلَكُوا اسْتِطَاعَةَ الامْتِنَاعِ مِنْهُ دُونَكَ
records.transliteration: tashkuru yasira ma shukirtahu wa tuthibu 'ala qaleelin ma tuta'afihu ḥattá ka'anna shukra ʿibādika alladhī awjabta ʿalayhi thawābahum wa'aẓamt(a) ʿanhu jazāʾahum amrun malakū istiṭāʿata al-imtināʿi minhu dūnaka
records.english_text: Thou showest gratitude for the paltry for which gratitude is shown to Thee and Thou rewardest the small act in which Thou art obeyed, so that it seems as if Thy servants' thanksgiving for which Thou hast made incumbent their reward and made great their repayment is an affair from which they could have held back without Thee,

records.arabic_text: فَكَافَيْتَهُمْ أَوْ لَمْ يَكُنْ سَبَبُهُ بِيَدِكَ فَجَازَيْتَهُمْ،
records.transliteration: fakaafaytahum aw lam yakun sababuhu biyadika fajaazaytahum
records.english_text: and hence Thou wilt recompense them, and whose cause is not in Thy hand, and hence Thou wilt repay them.

records.arabic_text: بَـلْ مَلَكْتَ يَا إلهِي أَمْرَهُمْ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَمْلِكُوا عِبَادَتَكَ، وَأَعْدَدْتَ ثَوَابَهُمْ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُفِيضُوا فِي طَاعَتِكَ،
records.transliteration: bal malakta yā ilāhī amrahum qabla an yamlikū ibādataka wa'aʿdadta thawābahum qabla an yufīḍū fī ṭāʿatika
records.english_text: Nay, my God, Thou hadst power over their affair before they had power to worship Thee, and Thou hadst prepared their reward before they began to obey Thee;

records.arabic_text: وَذَلِكَ أَنَّ سُنَّتَكَ الأِفْضَالُ، وَعَادَتَكَ الإحْسَانُ، وَسَبِيلَكَ الْعَفْوُ،
records.transliteration: wa dhalika anna sunnataka al-afḍal wa ʿadatka al-iḥsānu, wa sabīlaka al-ʿafwu
records.english_text: and that because Thy wont is bestowal of bounty, Thy custom beneficence, Thy way pardon.

records.arabic_text: فَكُلُّ الْبَرِيِّةِ مًعْتَرِفَةٌ بِأَنَّكَ غَيْرُ ظَالِم لِمَنْ عَاقَبْتَ، وَشَاهِدَةٌ بِأَنَّكَ مُتَفَضِّلٌ عَلَى مَنْ عَافَيْتَ،
records.transliteration: fakullu al-bariyyati muʿtarifatun bi-annaka ghayru ẓalim li-man ʿaqabta wa shāhidatun bi-annaka mutafadhdhilun ʿalā man ʿāfayta
records.english_text: So all creatures confess that Thou wrongest not him whom Thou punishest and bear witness that Thou bestowest bounty upon him whom Thou pardonest.

records.arabic_text: وَكُلٌّ مُقِرٌّ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ بِالتَّقْصِيْرِ عَمَّا اسْتَوْجَبْتَ،
records.transliteration: wa kullun muqirrun ʿalā nafsihi bi-t-taqṣīri ʿammā mustawjabt
records.english_text: Each admits that he has fallen short of what Thou meritest.

records.arabic_text: فَلَوْلا أَنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ يَخْتَدِعُهُمْ عَنْ طَاعَتِكَ ما عَصاكَ عاصٍ وَلَوْلا أَنَّهُ صَوَّرَ لَهُمُ البَاطِلَ فِي مِثَالِ الْحَقِّ مَا ضَلَّ عَنْ طَرِيْقِكَ ضَالٌّ.
records.transliteration: fala-wlā anna ash-shaytān-a yakh-taḍiʿuhum ʿan ṭāʿatika mā ʿaṣāka walawla annahu sawwara lahumul-batila fi mithali al-haqqi maḍalla ʿan ṭarīqika ḍāllun
records.english_text: Had Satan not misled them from Thy obedience, no disobeyer would have disobeyed Thee, and had he not shown falsehood to them in the likeness of truth no strayer would have gone astray from Thy path.

records.arabic_text: فَسُبْحَانَكَ مَا أَبْيَنَ كَرَمَكَ فِي مُعَامَلَةِ مَنْ أَطَاعَكَ أَوْ عَصَاكَ،
records.transliteration: fasubḥānaka mā ʾabyana karamaka fī muʿāmalati man ʾaṭāʿaka aw ʿaṣāka
records.english_text: So glory be to Thee! How manifest is Thy generosity in dealing with him who obeys or disobeys Thee!

records.arabic_text: تَشْكُرُ للْمُطِيْعِ مَا أَنْتَ تَوَلَّيْتَهُ لَهُ، وَتُمْلِي لِلْعَاصِي فِيْمَا تَمْلِكُ مُعَاجَلَتَهُ فِيْهِ،
records.transliteration: taškurul-limuṭīʿi mā ʾanta tawallaytahu lah wa tumli li-l-ʿāṣī fīmā tamliku muʿājalatahu fīhi
records.english_text: Thou showest gratitude to the obedient for that which Thou undertakest for him, and Thou grantest a respite to the disobedient in that within which Thou art able to hurry him.

records.arabic_text: أَعْطَيْتَ كُلاًّ مِنْهُمَا مَا لَمْ يَجِبْ لَهُ، وَتَفَضَّلْتَ عَلَى كُلٍّ مِنْهُمَا بِمَا يَقْصُرُ عَمَلُهُ عَنْهُ
records.transliteration: ʾaʿṭayta kullan minhuma mā lam yajib lah wa tafaḍḍaltu ʿalā kullin minhumā bimā yaqsuru ʿamaluhu ʿanhu
records.english_text: Thou givest to each of them that which is not his due, and Thou bestowest bounty upon each in that wherein his works fall short.

records.arabic_text: وَلَوْ كَافَأْتَ الْمُطِيعَ عَلَى مَا أَنْتَ تَوَلَّيْتَهُ لاَوْشَكَ أَنْ يَفْقِدَ ثَوَابَكَ، وَأَنْ تَزُولَ عَنْهُ نِعْمَتُكَ وَلكِنَّكَ بِكَرَمِكَ جَازَيْتَهُ
records.transliteration: wa law kāfā'ta al-muṭīʿa ʿalā mā ʾanta tawallaytahu lāw shakka ʾan yafqiḍa thawābak wa an tazūla ʿanhu niʿmatuka wa lakinnaka bikaramika jazaytahu
records.english_text: Wert Thou to counterbalance for the obedient servant that which Thou Thyself hadst undertaken, he would be on the point of losing Thy reward and seeing the end of Thy favour, but through Thy generosity Thou hast repaid him

records.arabic_text: عَلَى الْمُدَّةِ الْقَصِيرَةِ الفَانِيَةِ بِالْمُدَّةِ الطَّوِيلَةِ الْخَالِدَةِ، وَعَلَى الْغَايَةِ الْقَرِيبَةِ الزَّائِلَةِ بِالْغايَةِ الْمَدِيدَةِ الْبَاقِيَةِ،
records.transliteration: ʿalā al-muddati al-qaṣīrah al-fāniyah bil-muddati aṭ-ṭawīlah al-khālidah wa ʿalā al-ghāyati al-qarībah al-zāʾilah bil-ghāyati al-madīdah al-bāqiyah
records.english_text: for a short, perishing term with a long, everlasting term, and for a near, vanishing limit with an extended, abiding limit.

records.arabic_text: ثُمَّ لَمْ تَسُمْهُ الْقِصَاصَ فِيمَا أَكَلَ مِنْ رِزْقِكَ الَّذِي يَقْوَى بِهِ عَلَى طَاعَتِكَ، وَلَـمْ تَحْمِلْهُ عَلَى الْمُنَاقَشَاتِ فِي الآلاتِ الَّتِي تَسَبَّبَ بِاسْتِعْمَالِهَا إلَى مَغْفِـرَتِكَ،
records.transliteration: thumma lam tasumhu al-qisasa fee ma akala min rizqik alladhī yaqwá bihi ʿalá ṭāʿatika walam tahmilhu ʿalal-munāqašātifil-ālāt al-latī tasabbaba bi istiʿmālihā ilā maghfiratika
records.english_text: Then Thou dost not visit him with a settling of accounts for Thy provision through which he gained strength to obey Thee, nor dost Thou force him to make reckonings for the organs he employed to find the means to Thy forgiveness.

records.arabic_text: وَلَـوْ فَعَلْتَ ذلِكَ بِهِ لَذَهَبَ بِجَمِيْعِ مَا كَدَحَ لَهُ وَجُمْلَةِ مَا سَعَى فِيهِ، جَزَاءً لِلصُّغْرى مِنْ أَيادِيْكَ وَمِنَنِكَ،
records.transliteration: walaw faʿalta dhalika bihi laḏahaba bijamīʿi mā kadaha lah wa-jumlati mā saʿā fīhi jazā'an li-ṣ-ṣughrā min ayādīka wa minannika
records.english_text: Wert Thou to do that to him, it would take away everything for which he had laboured and all wherein he had exerted himself as repayment for the smallest of Thy benefits and kindnesses,

records.arabic_text: وَلَبَقِيَ رَهيناً بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ بِسَائِرِ نِعَمِكَ
records.transliteration: walabaqiya raheenan bayna yadayka bisa'iri ni'mika
records.english_text: and he would remain hostage before Thee for Thy other favours.

records.arabic_text: فَمَتَى كَانَ يَسْتَحِقُّ شَيْئاً مِنْ ثَوَابِكَ ، لا ، مَتَى؟.
records.transliteration: famataa kana yastahiqq shay'an min thawabika, la, mataa?
records.english_text: So how can he deserve something of Thy reward? Indeed, how?

records.arabic_text: هَذَا يا إلهِي حَالُ مَنْ أَطَاعَكَ وَسَبِيلُ مَنْ تَعَبَّدَ لَكَ،
records.transliteration: hādhā yā ilāhī ḥālu man aṭāʿaka wa sabīlu man taʿabbada laka
records.english_text: This, my God, is the state of him who obeys Thee and the path of him who worships Thee.

records.arabic_text: فَأَمَّا الْعَاصِيْ أَمْرَكَ وَالْمُوَاقِـعُ نَهْيَكَ فَلَمْ تُعَاجِلْهُ بِنَقِمَتِكَ لِكَيْ يَسْتَبْدِلَ بِحَالِهِ فِي مَعْصِيَتِكَ حَالَ الاِنَابَـةِ إلَى طَـاعَتِـكَ، وَلَقَـدْ كَـانَ يَسْتَحِقُّ فِي أَوَّلِ مَـا هَمَّ بِعِصْيَانِكَ
records.transliteration: fa'ammā al-ʿāṣiyu amraka wal-muwāqiʿu nahyaka falamm tuʿājilhu bināqimati-ka li-ky yastabdila bi-ḥāli-hi fī maʿṣiyatika ḥāla al-inābati ilā ṭāʿatika wa-laqad kāna yastahiqq fī awwali mā hamma bi-ʿiṣyānik
records.english_text: But as for him who disobeys Thy command and goes against Thy prohibition, Thou dost not hurry him to Thy vengeance, so that he may seek to replace his state in disobeying Thee with the state of turning back to obey Thee, though he deserved from the time he set out to disobey Thee

records.arabic_text: كُلَّ مَا أَعْدَدْتَ لِجَمِيعِ خَلْقِكَ مِنْ عُقُوبَتِكَ،
records.transliteration: kullamaa aʿdadta li-jameeʿi khalqika min ʿuqubatika
records.english_text: every punishment which Thou hast prepared for all Thy creatures.

records.arabic_text: فَجَمِيعُ مَا أَخَّرْتَ عَنْهُ مِنْ الْعَذَابِ، وَأَبْطَأتَ بِهِ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ سَطَوَاتِ النَّقِمَةِ وَالْعِقَابِ تَرْكٌ مِنْ حَقِّكَ، وَرِضىً بِدُونِ وَاجِبِكَ،
records.transliteration: fajamiʿu mā ʾakhkhartahū min al-ʿadhāb wa 'abta'ta bihi 'alayhi min satawaat al-naqimah wal-'iqaab tarakun min haqqika wa riḍān bidūni wājibika
records.english_text: Through each chastisement which Thou hast kept back from him and each penalty of Thy vengeance and Thy punishment which Thou hast delayed from him, Thou hast refrained from Thy right and shown good pleasure in place of what Thou hast made obligatory.

records.arabic_text: فَمَنْ أكْرَمُ يَا إلهِي مِنْكَ
records.transliteration: faman akramu ya ilahi minka
records.english_text: So who is more generous, my God, than Thou?

records.arabic_text: وَمَنْ أَشْقَى مِمَّنْ هَلَكَ عَلَيْـكَ، لا ، مَنْ؟
records.transliteration: wa-man ashqā mimman halaka ʿalayka, lā, man?
records.english_text: And who is more wretched than he who perishes in spite of Thee? Indeed, who?

records.arabic_text: فَتَبَارَكْتَ أَنْ تُوصَفَ إلاّ بِالإحْسَانِ، وَكَـرُمْتَ أَنْ يُخَافَ مِنْكَ إلاّ الْعَدْلُ،
records.transliteration: fatabarakt(a) 'an tuwṣaf(a) 'ill(a) bil-'iḥsān(i) wa karumta an yukhafa minka illa al-'adl
records.english_text: Thou art too blessed to be described by any but beneficence and too generous for any but justice to be feared from Thee!

records.arabic_text: لا يُخْشَى جَوْرُكَ عَلَى مَنْ عَصَاكَ، وَلاَ يُخَافُ إغْفَالُكَ ثَوَابَ مَنْ أَرْضَاكَ.
records.transliteration: lā yukhshā jawruka ʿalā man ʿasāka walā yukhāfu ʾiġfāluka thawāba man ʾarḍāka
records.english_text: There is no dread that Thou wilt be unjust toward him who disobeys Thee, nor any fear of Thy neglecting to reward him who satisfies Thee.

records.arabic_text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَهَبْ لِيْ أَمَلِي، وَزِدْنِي مِنْ هُدَاكَ مَا أَصِلُ بِهِ إلَى التَّوْفِيقِ فِي عَمَلِي،
records.transliteration: fasalli ʿala muhammadin wa ālihi wa hab li amalī wa zidni min hudak ma aṣilu bihī ilā al-tawfīq fī ʿamalī
records.english_text: So bless Muhammad and his Household, give me my hope, and increase me in that of Thy guidance through which I may be successful in my works!

records.arabic_text: إنَّكَ مَنَّانٌ كَرِيمٌ.
records.transliteration: 'innaka mannānun karīmun
records.english_text: Surely Thou art All-kind, Generous.

readings.title: 38. In asking Pardon
readings.attribution: Arabic, transliteration, and English translation from the Thaqalayn public-page dataset, released under CC0 1.0 Universal.

records.arabic_text: أَللَّهُمَّ إنِّي أَعْتَـذِرُ إلَيْـكَ مِنْ مَـظْلُوم ظُلِمَ بِحَضْرَتِي فَلَمْ أَنْصُرْهُ، وَمِنْ مَعْرُوف أُسْدِيَ إلَيَّ فَلَمْ أَشْكُرْهُ، وَمِنْ مُسِيء أعْتَذَرَ إلَيَّ فَلَمْ أَعْذِرْهُ،
records.transliteration: allāhumma innī aʿtaḏiru ilayk min maẓlūm ẓulima bi-ḥaḍratī falam anṣurhu wa-min ma'rūfin usdiya ilayya falam ashkurhu wa min musi'in a'thara ilayya falam a'zirhu
records.english_text: O God, I ask pardon from Thee for the person wronged in my presence whom I did not help, the favour conferred upon me for which I returned no thanks, the evildoer who asked pardon from me and whom I did not pardon,

records.arabic_text: وَمِنْ ذِيْ فَاقَة سَأَلَنِي فَلَمْ اُوثِرْهُ، وَمِنْ حَقِّ ذي حَقٍّ لَزِمَنِي لِمُؤْمِن فَلَمْ أوَفِّـرْهُ، وَمِنْ عَيْبِ مُؤْمِن ظَهَر لِي فَلَمْ أَسْتُرْهُ، وَمِنْ كُلِّ إثْم عَرَضَ لِيْ فَلَمْ أَهْجُرْهُ.
records.transliteration: wa-min dhī fāqah sa'alani falam ʾūthirhu wa min ḥaqqi dhī ḥaqqin lazimanī li-mu'min falam awaffirhu wa min ʿaybi al-muʾmin ẓahara lī falam asturhu wa min kulli ithmin 'aradha li falam ahjurhu
records.english_text: the needy person who asked from me and whom I preferred not over myself, the right of a believer who possesses a right incumbent upon me which I did not fulfil, the fault of a believer which became evident to me and which I did not conceal, and every sin which presented itself to me and which I failed to avoid.

records.arabic_text: أَعْتَذِرُ إلَيْكَ يَا إلهِي مِنْهُنَّ وَمِنْ نَظَائِرِهِنَّ اعْتِذَارَ نَدَامَة يَكُونُ وَاعِظاً لِمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيَّ مِنْ أَشْبَاهِهِنَّ.
records.transliteration: 'aṭaẓiru ilayka yā ilahī minhunna wa min naẓāʾirihi-nna iʿtiẓāra nadāmah yakunu wāʿiẓān limā bayna yadayya min ashbāhihinna
records.english_text: I ask pardon, my God, for all of these and their likes, with an asking of pardon in remorse which may act as an admonisher against similar things ahead of me.

records.arabic_text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَاجْعَلْ نَدَامَتِي عَلَى مَا وَقَعْتُ فِيهِ مِنَ الـزَّلاّتِ وَعَزْمِي عَلَى تَـرْكِ مَا يَعْـرِضُ لِيْ مِنَ السَّيِّئـاتِ تَوبَةً تُوجِبُ لِيْ مَحَبَّتَـكَ
records.transliteration: faṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih waajʿal nadāmati ʿalā mā waqaʿtu fīhi minalzallāti waʿazmī ʿalā tar-kī mā yaʿ-riḍu lī mina al-sayyiat tawbatun tu'jibu lī maḥabbatak
records.english_text: So bless Muhammad and his Household and make my remorse for the slips into which I have fallen and my determination to refrain from the evil deeds which present themselves to me a repentance which will make Thy love for me obligatory,

records.arabic_text: يا مُحِبَّ التَّوَّابِيْنَ.
records.transliteration: yā muḥibba al-tawwābīn
records.english_text: O lover of those who repent!

readings.title: 39. His Supplication in Seeking Pardon and Mercy
readings.arabicTitle: دُعَاؤُهُ فِي طَلَبِ الْعَفْوِ و المَغْفِرَةِ
readings.attribution: Arabic, transliteration, and English translation from the Thaqalayn public-page dataset, released under CC0 1.0 Universal.

records.arabic_text: أَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَاكْسِرْ شَهْوَتِي عَنْ كُـلِّ مَحْرَم، وَازْوِ حِـرْصِي عَنْ كُلِّ مَأثَم، وَامْنَعْنِي عَنْ أَذَى كُـلِّ مُؤْمِن وَمُؤْمِنَـة وَمُسْلِم وَمُسْلِمَة،
records.transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wa khsir shahwati ʿan kulli mahram wa azwī ḥirsī ʿan kulli mātham wa-amnaʿni ʿan adha kulli muʾminin wa muʾminatin wa muslimin wa muslima
records.english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, break my passion for every unlawful thing, take away my craving for any sin, and bar me from harming any believer, male or female, and any Muslim, male or female!

records.arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ وَأَيُّمَا عَبْد نالَ مِنِّي مَا حَظَرْتَ عَلَيْهِ، وَانْتَهَكَ مِنِّي مَا حَجَرْتَ عَلَيْهِ، فَمَضَى بِظُلاَمَتِي مَيِّتاً، أَوْ حَصَلَتْ لِيْ قِبَلَهُ حَيّاً،
records.transliteration: allāhumma wa ayyuma ʿabdin nāla minnī mā ḥaẓarta ʿalayhi wa-antahaka minni maa hajar-ta ʿalayhi famadha biẓulamati mayyitan aw ḥaṣalat lī qibalahu ḥayyan
records.english_text: O God, if any of Thy servants should harm me in what Thou hast forbidden or violate me in what Thou hast interdicted, and if he should pass into death with my complaint or I come to have a complaint against him while he is alive,

records.arabic_text: فَاغْفِرْ لَهُ مَا أَلَمَّ بِهِ مِنِّي، وَاعْفُ لَهُ عَمَّا أَدْبَرَ بِهِ عَنِّي،
records.transliteration: faghfir lahu ma alamma bihi minni waʿfu lahu ʿammā adbara bihi ʿannī
records.english_text: forgive him what he did to me and pardon him that through which he turned his back on me!

records.arabic_text: وَلاَ تَقِفْـهُ عَلَى مَا ارْتَكَبَ فِيَّ، وَلاَ تَكْشِفْهُ عَمَّا اكْتَسَبَ بِيْ،
records.transliteration: walā taqifhū ʿalā mā irtakaba fīy wala takshifhu ʿamma-aktasaba biy
records.english_text: Inquire not from him about what he committed toward me and expose him not through what he earned by me!

records.arabic_text: وَاجْعَلْ مَا سَمَحْتُ بِهِ مِنَ الْعَفْـوِ عَنْهُمْ وَتَبَرَّعْتُ بِـهِ مِنَ الصَّدَقَةِ عَلَيْهِمْ أَزْكَى صَدَقَاتِ الْمُتَصَدِّقِينَ وَأَعْلَى صِلاَتِ الْمُتَقَرِّبِينَ،
records.transliteration: wa-jʿal mā samaḥtu bihi min al-ʿafwi ʿanhum wa tabarratʿtu bihi mina al-ṣadaqati ʿalayhim ʾazkā ṣadaqāt al-mutaṣaddiqīn wa'aʿlaa ṣalāt al-mutaqarrabīn
records.english_text: Make my open-handedness in pardoning such servants and my contribution in charity toward them the purest charity of the charitable and the highest gift of those seeking nearness to Thee!

records.arabic_text: وَعَوِّضْنِي مِنْ عَفْوِي عَنْهُمْ عَفْوَكَ وَمِنْ دُعَائِي لَهُمْ رَحْمَتَكَ حَتَّى يَسْعَدَ كُلُّ وَاحِد مِنَّا بِفَضْلِكَ وَيَنْجُوَ كُلٌّ مِنَّا بِمَنِّكَ.
records.transliteration: wa ʿawwidhni min ʿafwi ʿanhum ʿafwaka wa min du'āʾī lahum raḥmataka ḥattā yasʿada kullu wāḥidin minnā bifadlika wayanjū kullun minnā bimannika
records.english_text: Recompense me for my pardoning them with Thy pardon and for my supplicating for them with Thy mercy so that each one of us may gain felicity through Thy bounty and each may attain deliverance through Thy kindness!

records.arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ وَأَيُّما عَبْد مِنْ عَبِيْدِكَ أدرَكَهُ مِنِّي دَرَكٌ أَوْ مَسَّهُ مِنْ نَاحِيَتِي أَذَىً، أَوْ لَحِقَـهُ بِي أَوْ بِسَبَبي ظُلْمٌ فَفُتُّهُ بِحَقِّـهِ،
records.transliteration: allāhumma wa-ayyuma ʿabd min ʿibādik ʾadrakah minnī darakun aw massahū min nāḥiyatī ʾaẓāan aw lahiqahu biyy aw bisababi dhulmun fafuttuhu bihaqqihi
records.english_text: O God, if there is a servant from among Thy servants whom an ill visits on my account, a harm touches from my direction, or a wrong overtakes through me or because of me, and should I fail to take care of his right

records.arabic_text: أَوْسَبَقْتُهُ بِمَظْلَمَتِهِ، فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، وَأَرْضِهِ عَنِّي مِنْ وُجْدِكَ، وَأَوْفِهِ حَقَّهُ مِنْ عِنْدِكَ،
records.transliteration: ʾawsabaqtu-hu bi-maẓlamati-hi fa ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wa-arḍihi ʿannī min wujdika, wa-awfihu ḥaqqahu min ʿindika
records.english_text: or go before him [in death] with his complaint, bless Muhammad and his Household, satisfy him toward me through Thy wealth, and give him his full right from Thyself!

records.arabic_text: ثُمَّ قِنيْ مَا يُوجِبُ لَهُ حُكْمُكَ، وَخَلِّصْنِي مِمَّا يَحْكُمُ بِهِ عَدْلُكَ، فَإنَّ قُوَّتِي لا تَسْتَقِلُّ بِنَقِمَتِكَ، وَإنَّ طَاقتِي لا تَنْهَضُ بِسُخْطِكَ،
records.transliteration: thumma qinī mā yūjibuhu ḥukmuka wa khalliṣnī mimma yahkumu bihi ʿadluka fa'inna quwwati la tastaqillu binagimatika wa'innataqatī lā tanhadhu bisukhtika
records.english_text: Then protect me from what Thy decision mandates and save me from what Thy justice decides, for my strength cannot bear Thy vengeance and my power cannot stand up to Thy displeasure!

records.arabic_text: فَإنَّكَ إنْ تُكَـافِنِي بِالْحَقِّ تُهْلِكْنِي، وَإلاّ تَغَمَّـدْنِي بِرَحْمَتِكَ تُوبِقْنِي.
records.transliteration: fa'innaka in tukafini bilhaqqi tuhlíkni wa-illā taghammadnī birahmatika tūbiq-nī
records.english_text: If Thou recompensest me with the right, Thou wilt destroy me, and if Thou dost not shield me in Thy mercy, Thou wilt lay me waste.

records.arabic_text: أللَّهُمَّ إنِّي أَسْتَوْهِبُكَ يَا إلهِي مَا لا يَنْقُصُكَ بَذْلُهُ، وَأَسْتَحْمِلُكَ مَا لا يَبْهَظُكَ حَمْلُهُ، أَسْتَوْهِبُكَ يَا إلهِي نَفْسِيَ الَّتِيْ لَمْ تَخْلُقْهَا لِتَمْتَنِعَ بِهَا مِنْ سُوء، أَوْ لِتَطَرَّقَ بِهَا إلى نَفْع،
records.transliteration: allāhumma innī astawhibuka yā ilāhī mā lā yanqusuka badluhu wa-astahmiluka ma la yabhathuka hamluhu astauhibuka ya ilahi nafsiya allati lam takhlukha litamtani'a biha min su' aw litatarraq biha ila nafʿ
records.english_text: O God, I ask Thee to grant, my God, that whose giving will not decrease Thee, and I ask Thee to carry that whose carrying will not weigh Thee down: My God, I ask Thee to give my soul, which Thou didst not create to keep Thyself from evil nor to find the way to profit.

records.arabic_text: وَلكِنْ أَنْشَأتَهَا إثْبَاتاً لِقُدْرَتِكَ عَلَى مِثْلِهَا، وَاحْتِجَاجاً بِهَا عَلَى شَكْلِهَا،
records.transliteration: walakin ansha'tahā ithbātan liqudrati-ka 'alā mithli-hā waḥtiǧājan bihā ʿalā shaklihā
records.english_text: No, Thou brought it forth to demonstrate Thy power over its like and to provide an argument against its similar.

records.arabic_text: وَأَسْتَحْمِلُكَ مِنْ ذُنُوبِي مَا قَدْ بَهَظَنِي حَمْلُهُ، وَأَسْتَعِينُ بِكَ عَلَى مَا قَدْ فَدَحَنِي ثِقْلُهُ.
records.transliteration: wa-astahmiluka min dhunubi ma qad bahazhani hamluhu wa astaʿīnu bika ʿalā mā qad fadaḥanī thiqluhu
records.english_text: I ask Thee to carry those of my sins whose carrying weighs me down and I seek help from Thee in that whose heaviness oppresses me.

records.arabic_text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، وَهَبْ لِنَفْسِي عَلَى ظُلْمِهَا نَفْسِيْ، وَوَكِّلْ رَحْمَتَكَ بِاحْتِمَالِ إصْرِي،
records.transliteration: faṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wahab li nafsi ʿala ẓulmiha nafsi wa wakkill raḥmataka bi-iḥtimāli iṣrī
records.english_text: So bless Muhammad and his Household, give to me my soul in spite of its wrongdoing, and appoint Thy mercy to carry my burden!

records.arabic_text: فَكَمْ قَدْ لَحِقَتْ رَحْمَتُكَ بِالْمُسِيئِينَ،
records.transliteration: fakam qad lahiqat rahmatuka bil musii'in
records.english_text: How many evildoers Thy mercy has overtaken!

records.arabic_text: وَكَمْ قَدْ شَمِلَ عَفْوُكَ الظَّالِمِينَ.
records.transliteration: wa kam qad shamilafu ka al-thalimeen
records.english_text: How many wrongdoers Thy pardon has embraced!

records.arabic_text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، وَاجْعَلْنِي أُسْوَةَ مَنْ قَدْ أَنْهَضْتَهُ بِتَجَاوُزِكَ عَنْ مَصَارِعِ الْخَاطِئِينَ، وَخَلَّصْتَهُ بِتَوْفِيقِكَ مِنْ وَرَطَاتِ الْمُجْرِمِينَ، فَأَصْبَحَ طَلِيقَ عَفْوِكَ مِنْ إسَارِ سُخْطِكَ،
records.transliteration: fa sallī ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihi, wajʿalnī uswatam man qad anhadtahu. bi-tajāwuzika ʿan maṣāriʿi l-khāṭiʾīn wa khallass-tahu bi tawfiqika min warataatil mujrimeen fa-asbaha ṭalīqa ʿafwik mni iṣāri sukḥtik
records.english_text: So bless Muhammad and his Household and make me the model of him whom Thou hast aroused through Thy forbearance from the deadly infirmities of the offenders and saved through Thy giving success from the tangled plights of the sinners, so that I may rise up freed by Thy pardon from the bonds of Thy displeasure

records.arabic_text: وَعَتِيقَ صُنْعِكَ مِنْ وَثَاقِ عَدْلِكَ،
records.transliteration: waʿatīqa su-nʿika min wathāqi ʿadlika
records.english_text: and released by Thy benefaction from the ties of Thy justice!

records.arabic_text: إنَّكَ إنْ تَفْعَلْ ذَلِكَ يَا إلهِي تَفْعَلْهُ بِمَنْ لاَ يَجْحَدُ اسْتِحْقَاقَ عُقُوبَتِكَ، وَلاَ يُبَرِّئُ نَفْسَهُ مِنِ اسْتِيجَابِ نَقِمَتِكَ،
records.transliteration: 'innaka 'in taf'al dhalika ya ilahi taf'alhu bi-man lā yajhadu istiḥqāqa ʿuqūbatika wa lā yubarri'u nafsahu min istijāb naqimatak
records.english_text: Surely if Thou dost that, my God, Thou wilt do it to one who does not deny deserving Thy punishment or acquit himself from merit for Thy vengeance.

records.arabic_text: تَفْعَلُ ذلِكَ يَا إلهِي بِمَنْ خَوْفُهُ مِنْكَ أَكْثَرُ مِنْ طَمَعِهِ فِيكَ، وَبِمَنْ يَأْسُهُ مِنَ النَّجَاةِ أَوْكَدُ مِنْ رَجَائِهِ لِلْخَلاَصِ،
records.transliteration: tafʿalu dhalika yā ilahī biman khawfuhu minka aktharu min tamaʿihi fīk wa biman yasuhu minan najati awkadu min rajaihi lil-khalas
records.english_text: Do that, my God, for one whose fear of Thee is greater than his craving from Thee, whose hopelessness of deliverance is firmer than his hope for salvation!

records.arabic_text: لاَ أَنْ يَكُونَ يَأْسُهُ قُنُوطَاً أَوْ أَنْ يَكُونَ طَمَعُهُ اغْتِرَاراً
records.transliteration: lā ʾan yakūna yaʾsuhu qunūṭān aw ʾan yakūna ṭamahu ightirāran
records.english_text: Not that his hopelessness is despair, nor that his expectation is deluded.

records.arabic_text: بَلْ لِقِلَّةِ حَسَنَاتِهِ بَيْنَ سَيِّئاتِهِ، وَضَعْفِ حُجَجِهِ فِي جَمِيعِ تَبِعَاتِهِ،
records.transliteration: bal liqillati hasanatihi bayna sayyi'atih waḍaʿfi ḥujajihi fī jamiʿi tabiʿātihi
records.english_text: No, rather his good deeds are few among his evil deeds and his arguments are frail in face of everything due from his acts.

records.arabic_text: فَأَمَّا أَنْتَ يَا إلهِي فَأَهْلٌ أَنْ لاَ يَغْتَرَّ بِكَ الصِّدِّيقُونَ، وَلاَ يَيْأَسَ مِنْكَ الْمُجْرِمُونَ، لاَِنَّكَ ألرَّبُّ الْعَظِيمُ الَّذِيْ لاَ يَمْنَعُ أَحَداً فَضْلَهُ
records.transliteration: fa'amman anta ya ilahi fa'ahlun an lā yaghṭarr bika ṣ-ṣid-dīqūn walā yaiʾasa minka al-mujrimūn lānaka al-rabbu al-ʿaẓīmu alladhī lā yamnaʿu aḥadan faḍlahu
records.english_text: But Thou, my God, art worthy that the righteous not be deluded concerning Thee and the sinners not lose hope in Thee, for Thou art the All-mighty Lord who holds back His bounty from none

records.arabic_text: وَلاَ يَسْتَقْصِي مِنْ أَحَد حَقَّـهُ.
records.transliteration: wa lā yastaqsī min aḥad ḥaqquh
records.english_text: and takes His full right from no one.

records.arabic_text: تَعَالى ذِكْرُكَ عَنِ الْمَذْكُورِينَ،
records.transliteration: taʿālá dhikruka ʿani al-madhdhūrīn
records.english_text: High exalted is Thy mention above those mentioned!

records.arabic_text: وَتَقَدَّست أَسْمَاؤُكَ عَنِ الْمَنْسُوبِينَ،
records.transliteration: wataqaddast asmā'uka 'anil-mansūbīn
records.english_text: Holy are Thy names beyond those described!

records.arabic_text: وَفَشَتْ نِعْمَتُكَ فِيْ جَمِيْعِ الْمَخْلُوقِينَ،
records.transliteration: wa fashat niʿmatuka fī jamiʿ al-makhlooqeen
records.english_text: Spread is Thy favour among all creatures!

records.arabic_text: فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى ذَلِكَ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِينَ .
records.transliteration: falaka al-ḥamdu ʿalā dhālika yā rabba al-ʿālamīn
records.english_text: Thine is the praise for that, O Lord of the worlds!

readings.title: 40. When he remembered Death
readings.attribution: Arabic, transliteration, and English translation from the Thaqalayn public-page dataset, released under CC0 1.0 Universal.

records.arabic_text: أَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ، وَاكْفِنَا طُـولَ الأمَـلِ، وَقَصِّرْهُ عَنَّا بِصِدْقِ الْعَمَلِ حَتَّى لا نُؤَمِّلَ اسْتِتْمَامَ سَاعَةٍ بَعْدَ سَاعَةٍ وَلاَ اسْتِيفَاءَ يَوْمٍ بَعْدَ يَوْمٍ،
records.transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihī wākinā ṭūla al-amal, waqaṣṣirhu ʿannā biṣidqi al-ʿamal ḥattá lā nuʾammila istitmāma sāʿatin baʿda sāʿaẗin wa lā istīfāʾa yawmin baʿda yawm
records.english_text: O God, Bless Muhammad and his Household, spare us drawn out expectations and cut them short in us through sincerity of works, that we may not hope expectantly for completing an hour after an hour, closing a day after a day,

records.arabic_text: وَلاَ اتِّصَالَ نَفَسٍ بِنَفَس، وَلا لُحُـوقَ قَدَمٍ بِقَـدَم.
records.transliteration: wa lā ittiṣāla nafsin binafs wa lā luḥūqa qadamin biqadam
records.english_text: joining a breath to a breath, or overtaking a step with a step!

records.arabic_text: وَسَلِّمْنَا مِنْ غُرُورِهِ، وَآمَنَّا مِنْ شُـرُوْرِهِ، وَانْصِبِ المَوْتَ بَيْنَ أَيْدِينَا نَصْباً،
records.transliteration: wasallimna min ghururihi, wa amanna min shuroorihi wa-anṣibi al-mawta bayna ʾaydinā naṣban
records.english_text: Keep us safe from the delusions of expectations, make us secure from their evils, set up death before us in display.

records.arabic_text: وَلاَ تَجْعَلْ ذِكْرَنَا لَهُ غِبّاً،
records.transliteration: walā tajʿal dhikranā lahu ghībban
records.english_text: and let not our remembering of it come and go!

records.arabic_text: وَاجْعَلْ لَنَا مِنْ صَالِحِ الأعْمَـالِ عَمَلاً نَسْتَبْطِئُ مَعَهُ الْمَصِيرَ إلَيْكَ، وَنحْـرِصُ لَهُ عَلَى وَشْكِ اللِّحَاقِ بِكَ حَتَّى يَكُونَ الْمَوْتُ مَأنَسَنَا الَّذِي نَأنَسُ بِهِ،
records.transliteration: wa-jʿal-lanā min ṣāliḥi al-aʿmāl ʿamalan nastabṭiʾu maʿahu al-maṣīr ilayk wa-naḥrisu lahu ʿalā waškil-liḥāqi bika ḥattá yakūna al-mawtu ma'anasanā alladhī ná'nasu bihī
records.english_text: Appoint for us from among the righteous works a work through which we will feel the homecoming to Thee as slow and crave a quick joining with Thee, so that death may be our intimate abode with which we are intimate,

records.arabic_text: وَمَألَفَنَا الَّذِي نَشْتَاقُ إلَيْهِ، وَحَامَّتَنَا الَّتِي نُحِبُّ الدُّنُوَّ مِنْهَا
records.transliteration: wa ma'alafana allathi nash'taq'u ilayhi, wa hammatana allati nuhibbu addunyawwa minha
records.english_text: our familiar place toward which we yearn, and our next of kin whose coming we love!

records.arabic_text: فَإذَا أَوْرَدْتَهُ عَلَيْنَا، وَأَنْزَلْتَهُ بِنَا فَأسْعِدْنَا بِهِ زَائِراً، وَآنِسْنَا بِهِ قَادِماً، وَلاَ تُشْقِنَا بِضِيافَتِهِ، وَلا تُخْزِنَا بِزِيارَتِهِ، وَاجْعَلْهُ بَاباً مِنْ أَبْوَابِ مَغْفِرَتِكَ،
records.transliteration: fa'idhā awradtahu ʿalaynā, wa-anzaltahu binā fa asʿidnā bihi zāʾiran, wa ānisnā bihi qādiman walā tušqinā biḍīāfatih, walā tukhzinā biziyāratih wa-jʿalhu bāban min abwābi maghfiratika
records.english_text: When Thou bringest it to us and sendest it down upon us, make us happy with it as a visitor, comfort us with its arrival, make us not wretched through entertaining it, degrade us not through its visit, and appoint it one of the gates to Thy forgiveness

records.arabic_text: وَمِفْتَاحاً مِنْ مَفَاتِيحِ رَحْمَتِكَ.
records.transliteration: wa-miftāḥan min mafātīḥi raḥmatika
records.english_text: and the keys to Thy mercy!

records.arabic_text: أَمِتْنَا مُهْتَدِينَ غَيْرَ ضَالِّينَ طائِعِينَ غَيْرَ مُسْتَكْرِهِينَ تَائِبينَ غَيْرَ عاصِينَ وَلا مُصِرِّينَ يَا ضَامِنَ جَزَاءِ الْمُحْسِنِينَ، وَمُسْتَصْلِحَ عَمَلِ الْمُفْسِدِينَ.
records.transliteration: amatna muhtadeen ghayra dhalilin ṭāʾiʿīna ghayra mustakrihīna tāʾibīna ghayra ʿāṣīna walā muṣirrīna yā ḍāminaj jazā' al-muḥsinīn wa mustaṣliḥa ʿamali al-mufsidiin
records.english_text: Make us die guided, not astray, obedient, not averse, repentant, not disobedient or persisting, O He who guarantees the repayment of the good-doers and seeks to set right the work of the corrupt!
